coverage_explanation: The catalogue is covered with independent analyst notes, which are not exhaustive reconstructive histories. For each source, refer to primary publisher text and deeper review where present; all author reports unverified independently.
limits: No byte-frozen primary-page snapshots or original publisher article hash
